from scipy.optimize import least_squares
base=[np.ones_like(x),x,v,x**3,x*v,x*x]
def model(p):
    g,w=p[0],p[1]
    env=np.exp(-g*t)
    A=np.column_stack(base+[env*np.cos(w*t),env*np.sin(w*t)])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    return A@c-dv_dt
best=None
for g0 in [-0.2,0.0,0.1,0.3]:
    s=least_squares(model,[g0,0.31])
    r=np.sum(s.fun**2)
    if best is None or r<best[0]: best=(r,s.x)
